text: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局：7月份，食品烟酒及在外餐饮类价格环比持平。食品中，畜肉类价格上涨1.9%，影响CPI上涨约0.07个百分点，其中猪肉价格上涨4.1%；鲜菜价格上涨1.3%，影响CPI上涨约0.02个百分点；鲜果价格下降3.8%，影响CPI下降约0.07个百分点；蛋类价格下降1.7%，影响CPI下降约0.01个百分点。其他七大类价格环比三涨两平两降。其中，教育文化娱乐、医疗保健、生活用品及服务价格分别上涨1.0%、0.8%和0.4%；居住、其他用品及服务价格均持平；交通通信、衣着价格分别下降2.2%和0.4%。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 9 - NBS: In July, prices for food, tobacco, alcohol, and dining-out were flat month-on-month. Among food, meat prices rose 1.9%, contributing about 0.07 percentage points to the CPI increase, with pork prices up 4.1%; fresh vegetable prices rose 1.3%, contributing about 0.02 percentage points to the CPI increase; fresh fruit prices fell 3.8%, contributing about 0.07 percentage points to the CPI decline; egg prices fell 1.7%, contributing about 0.01 percentage points to the CPI decline. Among the other seven major categories, three rose, two were flat, and two fell month-on-month. Among them, education, culture and entertainment, medical care and health, and household goods and services prices rose 1.0%, 0.8%, and 0.4% respectively; housing, and other goods and services prices were flat; transportation and communication, and clothing prices fell 2.2% and 0.4% respectively.
